title: MOOBEES
description: this resorcepack  makes bees look like cows (and 2 new bee variants that are looking like the 2 new cow variants)
body:
## What are Moobees?
**Moobees** are your **friendly bees** that make honey, but they are **cows** :D
### Types of Moobees:
- **Temperat Moobees** --- They mostly live in flower forests but can live in all temperate biomes.
- **Cold Moobees** --- They are **very rare** in nature, most of the times people artificaly start colonis. You can get them by breeding **temperate Moobees** in **cold biomes**
- **Warm Moobees** --- Though they are less rare naturaly, most of the times, to get them you will just breed **temperate Moobees** in **warm biomes**.

**_(Note: Cold Moobees can make Warm Moobees and vice versa as only the biome they are born in changes their looks._**
## Dependecies
[ETF mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
### Disclaimer
This resorcepack was made before the new cow varients were added so the spawning locations may not be 100% acurate
